profile.headline: Web Developer at iRacing
profile.summary: Consultant, specializing in Software Architecture & Engineering to solve complex business problems. Knowledgeable consultant and self-motivated to deliver quality solutions for business needs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St. Louis County, Missouri, United States
positions.description: Experience in working effectively with others to create a synergistic team environment. Effective at communicating and working with client and consultant teams comprised of technical and business owners to deliver valuable products and within tight deadlines. Software Engineer with experience in Python, R, JavaScript, SQL, react and redux.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked with Toyota's Racing Development Team for my thesis during my time at University of California, Irvine. Goal of this project was to develop a ranking algorithm for amateur auto racing drivers using lap to lap data. To accomplish this, we applied mixed effect models to longitudinal data allowing us to include driver specific random effects.
